# ============================================================
# STEP 1: DATASET ACQUISITION AND INITIAL VERIFICATION
# DANFIS-DE-NN - Interactive Preschool Learning
# ============================================================

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ============================================================
# 1. DATASET PATH
# ============================================================

DATASET_PATH = r"E:\Projects\2_ 4360\Dataset\interactive_preschool_learning_dataset.csv"

# ============================================================
# 2. CHECK WHETHER FILE EXISTS
# ============================================================

if not os.path.exists(DATASET_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"\nDataset file not found:\n{DATASET_PATH}"
    )

print("=" * 80)
print("STEP 1: DATASET ACQUISITION AND INITIAL VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 80)

print("\nDataset file found successfully.")
print("Path:", DATASET_PATH)

# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD DATASET
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

print("\nDataset loaded successfully.")

# ============================================================
# 4. DATASET SHAPE
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("DATASET SHAPE")
print("-" * 80)

print("Number of records :", df.shape[0])
print("Number of columns :", df.shape[1])

# ============================================================
# 5. COLUMN NAMES
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("COLUMN NAMES")
print("-" * 80)

for i, column in enumerate(df.columns, start=1):
    print(f"{i:02d}. {column}")

# ============================================================
# 6. DATA TYPES
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("DATA TYPES")
print("-" * 80)

print(df.dtypes)

# ============================================================
# 7. FIRST FIVE RECORDS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("FIRST 5 RECORDS")
print("-" * 80)

print(df.head())

# ============================================================
# 8. LAST FIVE RECORDS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("LAST 5 RECORDS")
print("-" * 80)

print(df.tail())

# ============================================================
# 9. MISSING VALUE CHECK
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("MISSING VALUE ANALYSIS")
print("-" * 80)

missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

missing_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "Column": df.columns,
    "Missing_Count": missing_values.values,
    "Missing_Percentage": (
        missing_values.values / len(df) * 100
    ).round(2)
})

print(missing_table.to_string(index=False))

print("\nTotal missing values:", df.isnull().sum().sum())

# ============================================================
# 10. DUPLICATE RECORD CHECK
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("DUPLICATE RECORD ANALYSIS")
print("-" * 80)

duplicate_count = df.duplicated().sum()

print("Duplicate records:", duplicate_count)

if duplicate_count == 0:
    print("No duplicate records detected.")
else:
    print("Duplicate records detected.")

# ============================================================
# 11. NUMERICAL AND CATEGORICAL COLUMNS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("NUMERICAL AND CATEGORICAL VARIABLES")
print("-" * 80)

numerical_columns = df.select_dtypes(
    include=[np.number]
).columns.tolist()

categorical_columns = df.select_dtypes(
    exclude=[np.number]
).columns.tolist()

print("\nNumerical columns:")
for col in numerical_columns:
    print(" -", col)

print("\nCategorical columns:")
for col in categorical_columns:
    print(" -", col)

print("\nNumber of numerical columns:", len(numerical_columns))
print("Number of categorical columns:", len(categorical_columns))

# ============================================================
# 12. TARGET VARIABLE
# ============================================================

TARGET_COLUMN = "Learning_Optimization_Level"

print("\n" + "-" * 80)
print("TARGET VARIABLE")
print("-" * 80)

if TARGET_COLUMN not in df.columns:
    print(
        f"WARNING: Target column '{TARGET_COLUMN}' "
        "was not found in the dataset."
    )
else:

    print("Target column:", TARGET_COLUMN)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Target class distribution
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    target_counts = df[TARGET_COLUMN].value_counts(
        dropna=False
    )

    target_percentages = (
        df[TARGET_COLUMN]
        .value_counts(normalize=True, dropna=False)
        .mul(100)
        .round(2)
    )

    target_distribution = pd.DataFrame({
        "Class": target_counts.index.astype(str),
        "Count": target_counts.values,
        "Percentage": [
            target_percentages.loc[x]
            for x in target_counts.index
        ]
    })

    print("\nTarget Class Distribution:")
    print(
        target_distribution.to_string(index=False)
    )

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# DATA PREPROCESSING AND Z-SCORE NORMALIZATION
# DANFIS-DE-NN
# Interactive Preschool Learning Dataset
# ============================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# ============================================================
# 1. FILE PATHS
# ============================================================

INPUT_PATH = r"E:\Projects\2_ 4360\Dataset\interactive_preschool_learning_dataset.csv"

OUTPUT_PATH = r"E:\Projects\2_ 4360\Dataset\interactive_preschool_learning_dataset_preprocessed.csv"

TARGET_COLUMN = "Learning_Optimization_Level"

RANDOM_STATE = 42
TEST_SIZE = 0.20

# ============================================================
# 2. CHECK INPUT FILE
# ============================================================

if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Input dataset not found:\n{INPUT_PATH}"
    )

print("=" * 90)
print("DATA PREPROCESSING AND Z-SCORE NORMALIZATION")
print("=" * 90)

# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD ORIGINAL DATASET
# ============================================================
df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_PATH)


# ============================================================
# 4. CHECK TARGET COLUMN
# ============================================================

if TARGET_COLUMN not in df.columns:
    raise KeyError(
        f"Target column '{TARGET_COLUMN}' was not found."
    )

# ============================================================
# 5. REMOVE EXACT DUPLICATE RECORDS
# ============================================================

duplicates_before = df.duplicated().sum()


if duplicates_before > 0:
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

duplicates_after = df.duplicated().sum()

# ============================================================
# 6. SEPARATE TARGET VARIABLE
# ============================================================

X = df.drop(columns=[TARGET_COLUMN]).copy()
y = df[TARGET_COLUMN].copy()

# ============================================================
# 7. IDENTIFY NUMERICAL AND CATEGORICAL FEATURES
# ============================================================

numerical_columns = X.select_dtypes(
    include=[np.number]
).columns.tolist()

categorical_columns = X.select_dtypes(
    exclude=[np.number]
).columns.tolist()

# ============================================================
# 8. CHECK MISSING VALUES BEFORE PROCESSING
# ============================================================

missing_before = df.isnull().sum()

missing_before_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "Column": missing_before.index,
    "Missing_Count": missing_before.values
})

missing_before_table = missing_before_table[
    missing_before_table["Missing_Count"] > 0
]

if len(missing_before_table) == 0:
    print("No missing values detected.")
else:
    print(
        missing_before_table.to_string(index=False)
    )

# ============================================================
# 9. STRATIFIED 80:20 TRAIN-TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================
# The split is performed BEFORE normalization so that the
# test set does not influence normalization parameters.

print("\n" + "-" * 90)
print("TRAIN-TEST SPLIT")
print("-" * 90)

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X,
    y,
    test_size=TEST_SIZE,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    stratify=y
)

print("Training samples:", len(X_train))
print("Testing samples :", len(X_test))

# ============================================================
# 10. COPY DATA FOR PREPROCESSING
# ============================================================

X_train_processed = X_train.copy()
X_test_processed = X_test.copy()

# ============================================================
# 11. HANDLE MISSING NUMERICAL VALUES
# ============================================================
# Median values are calculated ONLY from training data.

if len(numerical_columns) > 0:

    numerical_medians = X_train_processed[
        numerical_columns
    ].median()

    for column in numerical_columns:

        X_train_processed[column] = (
            X_train_processed[column]
            .fillna(numerical_medians[column])
        )

        X_test_processed[column] = (
            X_test_processed[column]
            .fillna(numerical_medians[column])
        )

else:
    print("No numerical features found.")

# ============================================================
# 12. HANDLE MISSING CATEGORICAL VALUES
# ============================================================
# Mode is calculated ONLY from training data.

if len(categorical_columns) > 0:

    categorical_modes = {}

    for column in categorical_columns:

        mode_values = X_train_processed[column].mode(
            dropna=True
        )

        if len(mode_values) > 0:
            fill_value = mode_values.iloc[0]
        else:
            fill_value = "Unknown"

        categorical_modes[column] = fill_value

        X_train_processed[column] = (
            X_train_processed[column]
            .fillna(fill_value)
        )

        X_test_processed[column] = (
            X_test_processed[column]
            .fillna(fill_value)
        )

else:
    print("No categorical features found.")

# ============================================================
# 13. Z-SCORE NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================

scaler = StandardScaler()

if len(numerical_columns) > 0:

    # FIT ONLY ON TRAINING DATA
    X_train_processed[numerical_columns] = scaler.fit_transform(
        X_train_processed[numerical_columns]
    )

    # APPLY TRAINING PARAMETERS TO TEST DATA
    X_test_processed[numerical_columns] = scaler.transform(
        X_test_processed[numerical_columns]
    )

else:
    print("No numerical features available for normalization.")

# ============================================================
# 14. RESTORE TARGET VARIABLE
# ============================================================

train_processed = X_train_processed.copy()
train_processed[TARGET_COLUMN] = y_train.values

test_processed = X_test_processed.copy()
test_processed[TARGET_COLUMN] = y_test.values

# ============================================================
# 15. ADD DATA SPLIT IDENTIFIER
# ============================================================

train_processed["Data_Split"] = "Train"
test_processed["Data_Split"] = "Test"

# ============================================================
# 16. COMBINE TRAINING AND TEST DATA
# ============================================================

processed_df = pd.concat(
    [train_processed, test_processed],
    axis=0,
    ignore_index=True
)

# ============================================================
# 17. SHUFFLE FINAL PROCESSED DATA
# ============================================================
# The Data_Split column preserves the partition information.

processed_df = processed_df.sample(
    frac=1,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
).reset_index(drop=True)

# ============================================================
# 18. FINAL MISSING-VALUE CHECK
# ============================================================

total_missing = processed_df.isnull().sum().sum()


# ============================================================
# 19. FINAL DUPLICATE CHECK
# ============================================================
final_duplicates = processed_df.duplicated().sum()

# ============================================================
# 20. VERIFY NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================


if len(numerical_columns) > 0:

    train_means = processed_df.loc[
        processed_df["Data_Split"] == "Train",
        numerical_columns
    ].mean()

    train_stds = processed_df.loc[
        processed_df["Data_Split"] == "Train",
        numerical_columns
    ].std()

    normalization_check = pd.DataFrame({
        "Feature": numerical_columns,
        "Train_Mean": train_means.values,
        "Train_Std": train_stds.values
    })
# ============================================================
# 21. TARGET DISTRIBUTION AFTER SPLIT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "-" * 90)
print("TARGET DISTRIBUTION")
print("-" * 90)

target_distribution = pd.crosstab(
    processed_df["Data_Split"],
    processed_df[TARGET_COLUMN]
)

print(target_distribution)

# ============================================================
# 22. SAVE PROCESSED DATASET
# ============================================================

processed_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_PATH,
    index=False
)

# ============================================================
# 23. FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY")
print("=" * 90)

print("Original dataset:")
print("  Records :", df.shape[0])
print("  Columns :", df.shape[1])

print("\nProcessed dataset:")
print("  Records :", processed_df.shape[0])
print("  Columns :", processed_df.shape[1])
print(processed_df.head())

print("\nOutput file:")
print(OUTPUT_PATH)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

INPUT_PATH = r"E:\Projects\2_ 4360\Dataset\interactive_preschool_learning_dataset_preprocessed.csv"

OUTPUT_PATH = r"E:\Projects\2_ 4360\Dataset\interactive_preschool_learning_dataset_feature_extracted.csv"

TARGET_COLUMN = "Learning_Optimization_Level"
SPLIT_COLUMN = "Data_Split"
ID_COLUMN = "Student_ID"

N_COMPONENTS = 9


# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD PREPROCESSED DATA
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_PATH)

print("Preprocessed shape:", df.shape)


# ============================================================
# 2. KEEP STUDENT_ID AS IDENTIFIER
# ============================================================

student_id = df[ID_COLUMN].copy()


# ============================================================
# 3. SEPARATE FEATURES
# ============================================================

X = df.drop(
    columns=[
        ID_COLUMN,
        TARGET_COLUMN,
        SPLIT_COLUMN
    ]
)

X_numeric = X.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])

target = df[TARGET_COLUMN]
data_split = df[SPLIT_COLUMN]


# ============================================================
# 4. TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================

train_mask = (
    data_split.astype(str)
    .str.lower()
    .str.strip()
    .isin(["train", "training"])
)

X_train = X_numeric.loc[train_mask]


# ============================================================
# 5. PCA FEATURE EXTRACTION — 12 FEATURES
# ============================================================

pca = PCA(n_components=9)

pca.fit(X_train)

X_pca = pca.transform(X_numeric)


# ============================================================
# 6. CREATE 12 PCA FEATURES
# ============================================================

feature_columns = [
    f"PC{i}"
    for i in range(1, 10)
]

feature_df = pd.DataFrame(
    X_pca,
    columns=feature_columns
)


# ============================================================
# 7. ADD COLUMNS IN REQUIRED ORDER
# ============================================================

feature_df.insert(
    0,
    ID_COLUMN,
    student_id.values
)

feature_df[TARGET_COLUMN] = target.values

feature_df[SPLIT_COLUMN] = data_split.values


# ============================================================
# 8. SAVE ONLY FEATURE-EXTRACTED CSV
# ============================================================

feature_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_PATH,
    index=False
)


# ============================================================
# 9. REQUIRED OUTPUT ONLY
# ============================================================

print("Number of features extracted:", len(feature_columns))
print("Preprocessed shape:", df.shape)
print("Feature extracted shape:", feature_df.shape)

print("\nFeature extracted head:")
print(feature_df.head())

import os

import numpy as np

from sklearn.model_selection import (
    StratifiedShuffleSplit,

    precision_score,
    recall_score,

    classification_report,

)

from scipy.optimize import differential_evolution

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# ============================================================
# 1. REPRODUCIBILITY
# ============================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(SEED)


# ============================================================
# 2. DATA PATH
# ============================================================

DATA_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\2_ 4360\Dataset"
    r"\interactive_preschool_learning_dataset_feature_extracted.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 3. COLUMN SETTINGS
# ============================================================

TARGET = "Learning_Optimization_Level"

SPLIT_COLUMN = "Data_Split"

INPUT_FEATURES = 9

feature_columns = [
    f"PC{i}"
    for i in range(1, INPUT_FEATURES + 1)
]


# ============================================================
# 4. CLASSES
# ============================================================

NUM_CLASSES = 4

class_names = [
    "Low",
    "Moderate",
    "High",
    "Excellent"
]

class_mapping = {
    "Low": 0,
    "Moderate": 1,
    "High": 2,
    "Excellent": 3
}


# ============================================================
# 5. DNN PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

DNN_HIDDEN_1 = 128

DNN_HIDDEN_2 = 64

DNN_HIDDEN_3 = 32

DNN_LEARNING_RATE = 0.001

DNN_BATCH_SIZE = 64

DNN_EPOCHS = 10

DNN_DROPOUT = 0.30


# ============================================================
# 6. ANFIS PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

ANFIS_INPUTS = 9

NUM_MF = 3

NUM_RULES = 27

ANFIS_LEARNING_RATE = 0.01


# ============================================================
# 7. DIFFERENTIAL EVOLUTION PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

DE_POPULATION = 20

DE_MUTATION = 0.50

DE_CROSSOVER = 0.90

DE_GENERATIONS = 5


# ============================================================
# 8. LOAD DATASET
# ============================================================

print("Loading dataset...")

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

print(
    "Dataset shape:",
    df.shape
)


# ============================================================
# 9. REQUIRED COLUMN CHECK
# ============================================================

required_columns = (
    [ID_COLUMN]
    + feature_columns
    + [TARGET, SPLIT_COLUMN]
)

missing_columns = [
    col
    for col in required_columns
    if col not in df.columns
]

if missing_columns:

    raise ValueError(
        f"Missing required columns: {missing_columns}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 10. REMOVE MISSING VALUES
# ============================================================

df = df.dropna(
    subset=feature_columns
    + [TARGET, SPLIT_COLUMN]
).copy()


# ============================================================
# 11. TARGET ENCODING
# ============================================================

if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(
    df[TARGET]
):

    y_all = (
        df[TARGET]
        .astype(int)
        .values
    )

else:

    y_all = (
        df[TARGET]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .map(class_mapping)
        .values
    )

    if np.isnan(y_all).any():

        unknown_classes = (
            df.loc[
                pd.isna(y_all),
                TARGET
            ]
            .unique()
            .tolist()
        )

        raise ValueError(
            f"Unknown target classes: "
            f"{unknown_classes}"
        )

    y_all = y_all.astype(int)


# ============================================================
# 12. INPUT FEATURES
# ============================================================

X_all = (
    df[feature_columns]
    .astype(np.float32)
    .values
)


# ============================================================
# 13. TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================

split_values = (
    df[SPLIT_COLUMN]
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

train_mask = (
    split_values
    .isin(
        ["train", "training"]
    )
    .values
)

test_mask = (
    split_values
    .isin(
        ["test", "testing"]
    )
    .values
)


# ============================================================
# 14. NUMERIC SPLIT FALLBACK
# ============================================================

if (
    train_mask.sum() == 0
    or test_mask.sum() == 0
):

    numeric_split = pd.to_numeric(
        df[SPLIT_COLUMN],
        errors="coerce"
    )

    train_mask = (
        numeric_split == 0
    ).values

    test_mask = (
        numeric_split == 1
    ).values


# ============================================================
# 15. VERIFY SPLIT
# ============================================================

if train_mask.sum() == 0:

    raise ValueError(
        "No training samples found."
    )

if test_mask.sum() == 0:

    raise ValueError(
        "No testing samples found."
    )


X_train = X_all[train_mask]

X_test = X_all[test_mask]

y_train = y_all[train_mask]

y_test = y_all[test_mask]


print(
    "Training samples:",
    X_train.shape[0]
)

print(
    "Testing samples :",
    X_test.shape[0]
)

print(
    "Training shape:",
    X_train.shape
)

print(
    "Testing shape :",
    X_test.shape
)


# ============================================================
# 16. CLASS DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

print(
    "\nTraining class distribution:"
)

train_counts = (
    pd.Series(y_train)
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

for i, name in enumerate(
    class_names
):

    print(
        f"{name}: "
        f"{train_counts.get(i, 0)}"
    )


print(
    "\nTesting class distribution:"
)

test_counts = (
    pd.Series(y_test)
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

for i, name in enumerate(
    class_names
):

    print(
        f"{name}: "
        f"{test_counts.get(i, 0)}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 17. INTERNAL TRAIN / VALIDATION SPLIT
# ============================================================
#
# The original 12,000 training samples are divided into:
#
# 85% model-training
# 15% validation
#
# The 3,000 test samples remain untouched.
# ============================================================

sss = StratifiedShuffleSplit(
    n_splits=1,
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=SEED
)

inner_train_idx, val_idx = next(
    sss.split(
        X_train,
        y_train
    )
)

X_model_train = X_train[
    inner_train_idx
]

y_model_train = y_train[
    inner_train_idx
]

X_validation = X_train[
    val_idx
]

y_validation = y_train[
    val_idx
]


# ============================================================
# 18. ONE-HOT ENCODING
# ============================================================

y_model_train_cat = (
    tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(
        y_model_train,
        NUM_CLASSES
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 19. DNN MODEL
# ============================================================

def build_dnn(
    input_dim
):

    model = tf.keras.Sequential([

        tf.keras.layers.Input(
            shape=(input_dim,)
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            DNN_HIDDEN_1,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
            DNN_DROPOUT
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            DNN_HIDDEN_2,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
            DNN_DROPOUT
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            DNN_HIDDEN_3,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
            DNN_DROPOUT
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            NUM_CLASSES,
            activation="softmax"
        )
    ])

    optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
        learning_rate=DNN_LEARNING_RATE
    )

    model.compile(
        optimizer=optimizer,
        loss="categorical_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    return model


# ============================================================
# 20. TRAIN DNN
# ============================================================

print("\nTraining DNN...")

dnn_start_time = time.perf_counter()

dnn_model = build_dnn(
    INPUT_FEATURES
)

history = dnn_model.fit(
    X_model_train,
    y_model_train_cat,
    validation_data=(
        X_validation,
        tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(
            y_validation,
            NUM_CLASSES
        )
    ),
    epochs=DNN_EPOCHS,
    batch_size=DNN_BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    verbose=0
)

dnn_training_time = (
    time.perf_counter()
    - dnn_start_time
)


dnn_history = history

dnn_train_accuracy = dnn_history.history["accuracy"]
dnn_val_accuracy = dnn_history.history["val_accuracy"]

dnn_train_loss = dnn_history.history["loss"]
dnn_val_loss = dnn_history.history["val_loss"]


# ============================================================
# 21. DNN PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================

dnn_prediction_start = (
    time.perf_counter()
)

dnn_train_prob = (
    dnn_model.predict(
        X_model_train,
        verbose=0
    )
)

dnn_validation_prob = (
    dnn_model.predict(
        X_validation,
        verbose=0
    )
)

dnn_test_prob = (
    dnn_model.predict(
        X_test,
        verbose=0
    )
)

dnn_inference_time = (
    time.perf_counter()
    - dnn_prediction_start
)


# ============================================================
# 22. DNN TEST PREDICTION
# ============================================================

dnn_test_pred = np.argmax(
    dnn_test_prob,
    axis=1
)


# ============================================================
# 23. DNN METRICS
# ============================================================

dnn_accuracy = accuracy_score(
    y_test,
    dnn_test_pred
)

dnn_precision = precision_score(
    y_test,
    dnn_test_pred,
    average="weighted",
    zero_division=0
)

dnn_recall = recall_score(
    y_test,
    dnn_test_pred,
    average="weighted",
    zero_division=0
)

dnn_f1 = f1_score(
    y_test,
    dnn_test_pred,
    average="weighted",
    zero_division=0
)


# ============================================================
# 24. ANFIS RULE GENERATION
# ============================================================
#
# 3 membership functions
# 3 antecedent variables
#
# 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 rules
# ============================================================

base_rules = list(
    itertools.product(
        range(NUM_MF),
        repeat=3
    )
)

rule_combinations = np.asarray(
    base_rules[:NUM_RULES],
    dtype=int
)


# ============================================================
# 25. GAUSSIAN MEMBERSHIP FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def gaussian_membership(
    x,
    center,
    sigma
):

    sigma = np.maximum(
        sigma,
        1e-6
    )

    return np.exp(
        -0.5
        *
        (
            (x - center)
            / sigma
        )
        ** 2
    )


# ============================================================
# 26. ANFIS PARAMETER INITIALIZATION
# ============================================================

def initialize_anfis_parameters(
    X,
    y
):

    centers = np.zeros(
        (
            ANFIS_INPUTS,
            NUM_MF
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    sigmas = np.zeros(
        (
            ANFIS_INPUTS,
            NUM_MF
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    for j in range(
        ANFIS_INPUTS
    ):

        values = X[:, j]

        centers[j] = np.percentile(
            values,
            [25, 50, 75]
        )

        std_value = np.std(
            values
        )

        if std_value < 1e-6:

            std_value = 1.0

        sigmas[j] = std_value

    consequents = np.zeros(
        (
            NUM_RULES,
            NUM_CLASSES
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    class_priors = np.bincount(
        y,
        minlength=NUM_CLASSES
    ).astype(float)

    class_priors = (
        class_priors
        /
        class_priors.sum()
    )

    for r in range(
        NUM_RULES
    ):

        consequents[r] = np.log(
            class_priors
            + 1e-8
        )

    return (
        centers,
        sigmas,
        consequents
    )


# ============================================================
# 27. ANFIS FORWARD FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def anfis_forward(
    X,
    centers,
    sigmas,
    consequents
):

    n_samples = X.shape[0]

    membership = np.zeros(
        (
            n_samples,
            ANFIS_INPUTS,
            NUM_MF
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Membership functions
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for j in range(
        ANFIS_INPUTS
    ):

        for m in range(
            NUM_MF
        ):

            membership[
                :,
                j,
                m
            ] = gaussian_membership(
                X[:, j],
                centers[j, m],
                sigmas[j, m]
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule firing strengths
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    firing_strengths = np.ones(
        (
            n_samples,
            NUM_RULES
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    for r, rule in enumerate(
        rule_combinations
    ):

        firing = np.ones(
            n_samples,
            dtype=np.float64
        )

        for antecedent_index in range(
            3
        ):

            mf_index = rule[
                antecedent_index
            ]

            firing *= membership[
                :,
                antecedent_index,
                mf_index
            ]

        firing_strengths[
            :,
            r
        ] = firing

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    firing_sum = (
        firing_strengths.sum(
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )
        + 1e-8
    )

    normalized_firing = (
        firing_strengths
        /
        firing_sum
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Sugeno weighted output
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    output = (
        normalized_firing
        @ consequents
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Softmax
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    output = (
        output
        -
        np.max(
            output,
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )
    )

    exp_output = np.exp(
        output
    )

    probabilities = (
        exp_output
        /
        (
            exp_output.sum(
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True
            )
            + 1e-8
        )
    )

    return probabilities


# ============================================================
# 28. ANFIS DATA
# ============================================================

X_anfis_train = (
    X_model_train[
        :,
        :ANFIS_INPUTS
    ]
)

X_anfis_validation = (
    X_validation[
        :,

    ]

    )

anfis_test_prob = anfis_forward(

)

)

anfis_f1 = f1_score(
    y_test,

    average="weighted",
    zero_division=0
)


# ============================================================
# 32. DE PARAMETER DIMENSION
# ============================================================

center_size = (
    ANFIS_INPUTS
    * NUM_MF
)

sigma_size = (
    ANFIS_INPUTS
    * NUM_MF
)

consequent_size = (
    NUM_RULES
    * NUM_CLASSES
)

DE_DIMENSION = (
    1
    + center_size
    + sigma_size
    + consequent_size
)


# ============================================================
# 33. DE BOUNDS
# ============================================================

bounds = []

# Fusion weight
bounds.append(
    (0.0, 1.0)
)

# Centers
for j in range(
    ANFIS_INPUTS
):

    min_value = np.min(
        X_anfis_train[:, j]
    )

    max_value = np.max(
        X_anfis_train[:, j]
    )

    for m in range(
        NUM_MF
    ):

        bounds.append(
            (
                min_value,
                max_value
            )
        )

# Sigmas
for j in range(
    ANFIS_INPUTS
):

    std_value = np.std(
        X_anfis_train[:, j]
    )

    if std_value < 1e-6:

        std_value = 1.0

    for m in range(
        NUM_MF
    ):

        bounds.append(
            (
                0.01 * std_value,
                3.0 * std_value
            )
        )

# Consequents
for _ in range(
    consequent_size
):

    bounds.append(
        (-5.0, 5.0)
    )


# ============================================================
# 34. DE FITNESS FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def decode_de_parameters(
    parameter_vector
):

    position = 0

    fusion_weight = (
        parameter_vector[position]
    )

    position += 1

    centers = (
        parameter_vector[
            position:
            position + center_size
        ]
        .reshape(
            ANFIS_INPUTS,
            NUM_MF
        )
    )

    position += center_size

    sigmas = (
        parameter_vector[
            position:
            position + sigma_size
        ]
        .reshape(
            ANFIS_INPUTS,
            NUM_MF
        )
    )

    position += sigma_size

    consequents = (
        parameter_vector[
            position:
            position + consequent_size
        ]
        .reshape(
            NUM_RULES,
            NUM_CLASSES
        )
    )

    return (
        fusion_weight,
        centers,
        sigmas,
        consequents
    )


def de_fitness(
    parameter_vector
):

    (
        fusion_weight,
        centers,
        sigmas,
        consequents
    ) = decode_de_parameters(
        parameter_vector
    )

    validation_anfis_prob = (
        anfis_forward(
            X_anfis_validation,
            centers,
            sigmas,
            consequents
        )
    )

    fused_prob = (
        fusion_weight
        * dnn_validation_prob
        +
        (1.0 - fusion_weight)
        * validation_anfis_prob
    )

    fused_prob = (
        fused_prob
        /
        (
            fused_prob.sum(
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True
            )
            + 1e-8
        )
    )

    selected_probability = (
        fused_prob[
            np.arange(
                len(y_validation)
            ),
            y_validation
        ]
    )

    selected_probability = np.clip(
        selected_probability,
        1e-8,
        1.0
    )

    loss = -np.mean(
        np.log(
            selected_probability
        )
    )

    return float(loss)


# ============================================================
# 35. TRAIN DE
# ============================================================

print("Training DE....")

de_start_time = (
    time.perf_counter()
)

de_result = differential_evolution(
    de_fitness,
    bounds=bounds,
    strategy="best1bin",
    maxiter=DE_GENERATIONS,
    popsize=DE_POPULATION,
    mutation=DE_MUTATION,
    recombination=DE_CROSSOVER,
    seed=SEED,
    polish=False,
    updating="immediate",
    workers=1
)

de_training_time = (
    time.perf_counter()
    - de_start_time
)


# ============================================================
# 36. DE BEST PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

(
    best_fusion_weight,
    best_centers,
    best_sigmas,
    best_consequents
) = decode_de_parameters(
    de_result.x
)

# ============================================================
# 37. PROPOSED MODEL
# ============================================================

print("Training Proposed Model...")

proposed_start_time = time.perf_counter()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Optimized ANFIS predictions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_anfis_train_prob = anfis_forward(
    X_anfis_train,
    best_centers,
    best_sigmas,
    best_consequents
)

final_anfis_validation_prob = anfis_forward(
    X_anfis_validation,
    best_centers,
    best_sigmas,
    best_consequents
)

final_anfis_test_prob = anfis_forward(
    X_anfis_test,
    best_centers,
    best_sigmas,
    best_consequents
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DNN + optimized ANFIS fusion
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_train_prob = (
    best_fusion_weight
    * dnn_train_prob
    +
    (1.0 - best_fusion_weight)
    * final_anfis_train_prob
)

final_validation_prob = (
    best_fusion_weight
    * dnn_validation_prob
    +
    (1.0 - best_fusion_weight)
    * final_anfis_validation_prob
)

final_test_prob = (
    best_fusion_weight
    * dnn_test_prob
    +
    (1.0 - best_fusion_weight)
    * final_anfis_test_prob
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalize probabilities
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_train_prob = (
    final_train_prob
    /
    (
        final_train_prob.sum(
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )
        + 1e-8
    )
)

final_validation_prob = (
    final_validation_prob
    /
    (
        final_validation_prob.sum(
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )
        + 1e-8
    )
)

final_test_prob = (
    final_test_prob
    /
    (
        final_test_prob.sum(
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )
        + 1e-8
    )
)

proposed_training_time = (
    time.perf_counter()
    - proposed_start_time
)

print("Proposed Model training completed.")

# ============================================================
# 38. PROPOSED MODEL PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================

proposed_test_pred = np.argmax(
    final_test_prob,
    axis=1
)


# ============================================================
# 39. PROPOSED MODEL METRICS
# ============================================================

proposed_accuracy = accuracy_score(
    y_test,
    proposed_test_pred
)

proposed_precision = precision_score(
    y_test,
    proposed_test_pred,
    average="weighted",
    zero_division=0
)

proposed_recall = recall_score(
    y_test,
    proposed_test_pred,
    average="weighted",
    zero_division=0
)

proposed_f1 = f1_score(
    y_test,

    zero_division=0
)

# ============================================================
# 40. FINAL TRAINING COMPLETED
# ===========================================================
print("Training completed")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE:
#
# To keep the CV computationally practical, each fold trains
# the DNN and evaluates the complete DNN+ANFIS fusion.
#
# The final DE-optimized model is reported separately above.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

skf = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=5,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=SEED
)

cv_rows = []

for fold_number, (
    fold_train_idx,
    fold_test_idx
) in enumerate(
    skf.split(
        X_train,
        y_train
    ),
    start=1
):

    fold_X_train = X_train[
        fold_train_idx
    ]

    fold_X_test = X_train[
        fold_test_idx
    ]

    fold_y_train = y_train[
        fold_train_idx
    ]

    fold_y_test = y_train[
        fold_test_idx
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DNN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    fold_model = build_dnn(
        INPUT_FEATURES
    )

    fold_y_train_cat = (
        tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(
            fold_y_train,
            NUM_CLASSES
        )
    )

    fold_model.fit(
        fold_X_train,
        fold_y_train_cat,
        epochs=DNN_EPOCHS,
        batch_size=DNN_BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        verbose=0
    )

    fold_dnn_prob = (
        fold_model.predict(
            fold_X_test,
            verbose=0
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ANFIS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    (
        fold_centers,
        fold_sigmas,
        fold_consequents
    ) = initialize_anfis_parameters(
        fold_X_train,
        fold_y_train
    )

    fold_anfis_prob = (
        anfis_forward(
            fold_X_test,
            fold_centers,
            fold_sigmas,
            fold_consequents
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Fusion
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fold_prob = (
        0.5 * fold_dnn_prob
        +
        0.5 * fold_anfis_prob
    )

    fold_pred = np.argmax(
        fold_prob,
        axis=1
    )

    fold_accuracy = accuracy_score(
        fold_y_test,
        fold_pred
    )

    fold_precision = precision_score(
        fold_y_test,
        fold_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    fold_recall = recall_score(
        fold_y_test,
        fold_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    fold_f1 = f1_score(
        fold_y_test,
        fold_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    cv_rows.append({

        "Fold": f"Fold {fold_number}",

        "Accuracy (%)":
            fold_accuracy * 100,

        "Precision (%)":
            fold_precision * 100,

        "Recall (%)":
            fold_recall * 100,

        "F1-Score (%)":
            fold_f1 * 100
    })


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CV dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cv_df = pd.DataFrame(
    cv_rows
)

cv_average = {

    "Fold": "Average",

    "Accuracy (%)":
        cv_df["Accuracy (%)"].mean(),

    "Precision (%)":
        cv_df["Precision (%)"].mean(),

    "Recall (%)":
        cv_df["Recall (%)"].mean(),

    "F1-Score (%)":
        cv_df["F1-Score (%)"].mean()
}

cv_std = {

    "Fold": "SD",

    "Accuracy (%)":
        cv_df["Accuracy (%)"].std(
            ddof=1
        ),

    "Precision (%)":
        cv_df["Precision (%)"].std(
            ddof=1
        ),

    "Recall (%)":
        cv_df["Recall (%)"].std(
            ddof=1
        ),

    "F1-Score (%)":
        cv_df["F1-Score (%)"].std(
            ddof=1
        )
}

cv_df = pd.concat(
    [
        cv_df,
        pd.DataFrame([
            cv_average,
            cv_std
        ])
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

print(
    cv_df.to_string(
        index=False,
        float_format=lambda x:
        f"{x:.2f}"
    )
)

# ============================================================
# RESULT 5
# ABLATION ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

print("\n")
print("=" * 95)
print("5. ABLATION ANALYSIS OF DANFIS-DE-NN")
print("=" * 95)


# ============================================================
# 5.1 DNN ONLY
# ============================================================

ablation_dnn_pred = (
    dnn_test_pred
)


# ============================================================
# 5.2 PCA + DNN
#
# Current X_test already contains PCA features.
# Therefore PCA + DNN uses the same trained DNN prediction.
# ============================================================

ablation_pca_dnn_pred = (
    dnn_test_pred
)


# ============================================================
# 5.3 PCA + DNN + ANFIS
#
# Fusion without DE optimization
# ============================================================

pca_dnn_anfis_probability = (

    0.5
    * dnn_test_prob

    +

    0.5
    * anfis_test_prob
)


pca_dnn_anfis_probability = (

    pca_dnn_anfis_probability

    /

    (
        pca_dnn_anfis_probability.sum(
            axis=1,
            keepdims=True
        )

        + 1e-8
    )
)


ablation_pca_dnn_anfis_pred = (

    np.argmax(

        pca_dnn_anfis_probability,

        axis=1
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 5.4 DANFIS-DE-NN [PROPOSED]
# ============================================================

ablation_proposed_pred = (
    proposed_test_pred
)


# ============================================================
# 5.5 ABLATION CONFIGURATIONS
# ============================================================

ablation_models = {

    "DNN only":
        ablation_dnn_pred,

    "PCA + DNN":
        ablation_pca_dnn_pred,

    "PCA + DNN + ANFIS":
        ablation_pca_dnn_anfis_pred,

    "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]":
        ablation_proposed_pred
}


# ============================================================
# 5.6 CALCULATE RESULTS
# ============================================================

ablation_rows = []


for model_name, predictions in (
    ablation_models.items()
):

        recall_score(

            zero_division=0

        * 100
    )

    f1_value = (

        f1_score(

            y_test,

            predictions,

            average="weighted",

            zero_division=0

        )
        * 100
    )


    ablation_rows.append({

        "Configuration":
            model_name,

        "Accuracy (%)":
            accuracy_value,

        "Recall (%)":
            recall_value,

        "F1-Score (%)":
            f1_value
    })


# ============================================================
# 5.7 CREATE DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

ablation_df = pd.DataFrame(
    ablation_rows
)

# 5.8 ROUND VALUES

ablation_df[

] = (

# ============================================================
# FULL ROBUSTNESS ANALYSIS
# DANFIS-DE-NN
# CURRENT DATASET: PC1-PC9
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score
)


# ============================================================
# 1. ROBUSTNESS CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

REDUCED_TRAINING_RATIO = 0.50

FEATURE_PERTURBATION_LEVEL = 0.10

INPUT_NOISE_STD = 0.05

ROBUSTNESS_RANDOM_STATE = 42


# ============================================================
# 2. DNN MODEL BUILDER
# ============================================================

def build_robustness_dnn(
    input_dim,
    num_classes
):

    model = tf.keras.Sequential([

        tf.keras.layers.Input(
            shape=(input_dim,)
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            128,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
            0.30
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            64,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dropout(
            0.30
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            32,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            num_classes,
            activation="softmax"
        )
    ])

    model.compile(

        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=0.001
        ),

        loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",

        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    return model


# ============================================================
# 3. ANFIS INITIALIZATION FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

def robustness_initialize_centers(
    X,
    num_mf
):

    X = np.asarray(
        X,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    n_features = X.shape[1]

    centers = np.zeros(
        (
            n_features,
            num_mf
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Percentile-based Gaussian MF centers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    percentile_positions = np.linspace(
        25,
        75,
        num_mf
    )

    for feature_idx in range(
        n_features
    ):

        centers[
            feature_idx
        ] = np.percentile(

            X[:, feature_idx],

            percentile_positions
        )

    return centers


def robustness_initialize_sigmas(
    X,
    num_mf
):

    X = np.asarray(
        X,
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    n_features = X.shape[1]

    sigmas = np.zeros(
        (
            n_features,
            num_mf
        ),
        dtype=np.float64
    )

    for feature_idx in range(
        n_features
    ):

        feature_std = np.std(
            X[:, feature_idx]
        )

        # Prevent zero sigma
        if feature_std < 1e-6:

            feature_std = 1.0

        sigmas[
            feature_idx,
            :
        ] = feature_std

    return sigmas


def robustness_initialize_consequents(
    num_rules,
    num_features,
    num_classes
):

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Consequent parameters
    #
    # Shape:
    # (rules, classes)
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    consequents = np.zeros(

        (
            num_rules,
            num_classes
        ),

        dtype=np.float64
    )

    return consequents


# ============================================================
# 4. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_robustness_metrics(
    y_true,
    probability_output
):

    y_pred = np.argmax(
        probability_output,
        axis=1
    )

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    return {

        "Accuracy (%)":
        accuracy * 100,

        "Precision (%)":
        precision * 100,

        "Recall (%)":
        recall * 100,

        "F1-Score (%)":
        f1 * 100
    }


# ============================================================
# 5. RESULTS STORAGE
# ============================================================

robustness_results = []


def append_robustness_result(

    scenario,

    model_name,

    y_true,

    probability_output
):

    metrics = calculate_robustness_metrics(

        y_true,

        probability_output
    )

    robustness_results.append({

        "Scenario Type":
        scenario,

        "Model":
        model_name,

        "Accuracy (%)":
        metrics["Accuracy (%)"],

        "Precision (%)":
        metrics["Precision (%)"],

        "Recall (%)":
        metrics["Recall (%)"],

        "F1-Score (%)":

    })

# ============================================================

required_main_variables = [

    "best_fusion_weight",

]


missing_main_variables = [

    variable

    for variable in required_main_variables

    if variable not in globals()
]


if len(missing_main_variables) > 0:

    raise NameError(

        "Missing variables from the main DANFIS-DE-NN "
        "implementation: "
        +
        ", ".join(
            missing_main_variables
        )
    )


# ============================================================
# 7. PROPOSED MODEL PREDICTION
# ============================================================

def robustness_proposed_prediction(

    X_input,

    dnn_probability
):

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ANFIS prediction
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    anfis_probability = anfis_forward(

        X_input[
            :,
            :ANFIS_INPUTS
        ],

        best_centers,

        best_sigmas,

        best_consequents
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DNN + ANFIS fusion
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    proposed_probability = (

        best_fusion_weight
        *
        dnn_probability

        +

        (1.0 - best_fusion_weight)
        *
        anfis_probability
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Probability normalization
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    proposed_probability = (

        proposed_probability

        /

        (

            proposed_probability.sum(

                axis=1,

                keepdims=True

            )

            + 1e-8

        )

    )


    return proposed_probability

# ============================================================
# MODEL COMPARISON / BASELINE RETRAINING
# SAME DATASET
# SAME 9 PCA FEATURES
# SAME TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# PRINT RESULTS ONLY
# NO FILES SAVED
# ============================================================

import os
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score
)

from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from xgboost import XGBClassifier

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# 1. REPRODUCIBILITY
# ============================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
tf.random.set_seed(SEED)

os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(SEED)


# ============================================================
# 2. USE EXISTING DATA
# ============================================================
#
# This block expects:
#
# X_model_train
# y_model_train
# X_test
# y_test
#
# from your DANFIS-DE-NN code.
#
# X_model_train = 10200 samples
# X_validation  = 1800 samples
# X_test        = 3000 samples
#
# For fair comparison, baseline models are trained on the
# complete original training set: X_train / y_train.
# ============================================================

print("\n")
print("=" * 100)
print("BASELINE MODEL COMPARISON")
print("=" * 100)

# Use the complete training set
# and untouched test set.

BASE_X_TRAIN = X_train.copy()
BASE_Y_TRAIN = y_train.copy()

BASE_X_TEST = X_test.copy()
BASE_Y_TEST = y_test.copy()

print(
    "Training samples:",
    BASE_X_TRAIN.shape[0]
)

print(
    "Testing samples :",
    BASE_X_TEST.shape[0]
)

print(
    "Number of features:",
    BASE_X_TRAIN.shape[1]
)


# ============================================================
# 3. RESULT STORAGE
# ============================================================

results = []


# ============================================================
# 4. COMMON METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(
    model_name,
    y_true,
    y_pred
):

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="weighted",
        zero_division=0
    )

    results.append({
        "Model": model_name,
        "Accuracy (%)": accuracy * 100,
        "Precision (%)": precision * 100,
        "Recall (%)": recall * 100,
        "F1-Score (%)": f1 * 100
    })

    print(
        f"{model_name:<30} "
        f"Accuracy={accuracy*100:>7.2f}%  "
        f"Precision={precision*100:>7.2f}%  "
        f"Recall={recall*100:>7.2f}%  "
        f"F1={f1*100:>7.2f}%"
    )


# ============================================================
# 5. NB ALGORITHM
# ============================================================
#
# Gaussian Naive Bayes
# ============================================================

print("\nTraining NB Algorithm...")

from sklearn.naive_bayes import GaussianNB

start = time.perf_counter()

nb_model = GaussianNB()

nb_model.fit(
    BASE_X_TRAIN,
    BASE_Y_TRAIN
)

nb_pred = nb_model.predict(
    BASE_X_TEST
)

nb_time = time.perf_counter() - start

calculate_metrics(
    "NB Algorithm",
    BASE_Y_TEST,
    nb_pred
)


# ============================================================
# 6. KNN
# ============================================================

print("\nTraining KNN...")

start = time.perf_counter()

knn_model = KNeighborsClassifier(
    n_neighbors=5,
    weights="distance",
    metric="euclidean",
    n_jobs=-1
)

knn_model.fit(
    BASE_X_TRAIN,
    BASE_Y_TRAIN
)

knn_pred = knn_model.predict(
    BASE_X_TEST
)

knn_time = time.perf_counter() - start

calculate_metrics(
    "KNN",
    BASE_Y_TEST,
    knn_pred
)


# ============================================================
# 7. SVM
# ============================================================

print("\nTraining SVM...")

start = time.perf_counter()

svm_model = SVC(
    kernel="rbf",

    gamma="scale",
    random_state=SEED
)

svm_model.fit(

)

svm_pred = svm_model.predict(
    BASE_X_TEST
)

calculate_metrics(
    "SVM",

# ============================================================

start = time.perf_counter()

dt_model = DecisionTreeClassifier(
    criterion="gini",
    max_depth=None,

dt_model.fit(

)

dt_pred = dt_model.predict(

)

calculate_metrics(

# 9. RANDOM FOREST ALGORITHM
# ============================================================

print("\nTraining Random Forest Algorithm...")

start = time.perf_counter()

rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=None,
    random_state=SEED,
    n_jobs=-1
)

rf_model.fit(
    BASE_X_TRAIN,
    BASE_Y_TRAIN
)

rf_pred = rf_model.predict(
    BASE_X_TEST
)

rf_time = time.perf_counter() - start

calculate_metrics(
    "Random Forest Algorithm",
    BASE_Y_TEST,
    rf_pred
)


# ============================================================
# 10. XGBOOST + TS-RESNET
# ============================================================

print("\nTraining XGBoost + TS-ResNet...")

start = time.perf_counter()

xgb_model = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=150,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.9,
    colsample_bytree=0.9,
    objective="multi:softprob",
    num_class=NUM_CLASSES,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    random_state=SEED,
    n_jobs=-1
)

xgb_model.fit(
    BASE_X_TRAIN,
    BASE_Y_TRAIN
)

xgb_train_features = xgb_model.predict_proba(
    BASE_X_TRAIN
)

xgb_test_features = xgb_model.predict_proba(
    BASE_X_TEST
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TS-ResNet-style residual classifier
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ts_input = tf.keras.Input(
    shape=(NUM_CLASSES,)
)

dense1 = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
    64,
    activation="relu"
)(ts_input)

dense2 = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
    64,
    activation="relu"
)(dense1)

residual = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
    64,
    activation=None
)(ts_input)

added = tf.keras.layers.Add()([
    dense2,
    residual
])

activated = tf.keras.layers.Activation(
    "relu"
)(added)

output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
    NUM_CLASSES,
    activation="softmax"
)(activated)

ts_resnet = tf.keras.Model(
    inputs=ts_input,
    outputs=output
)

ts_resnet.compile(
    optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
        learning_rate=0.001
    ),
    loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
    metrics=["accuracy"]
)

ts_resnet.fit(
    xgb_train_features,
    BASE_Y_TRAIN,
    epochs=10,

# ============================================================
# STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
# PAIRED T-TEST
#
# RETRAINED MODEL TEST-SET PREDICTIONS
# BASELINE vs DANFIS-DE-NN [PROPOSED]
#
# NO FILES ARE SAVED
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.stats import ttest_rel


# ============================================================
# 1. SIGNIFICANCE LEVEL
# ============================================================

ALPHA = 0.05


# ============================================================
# 2. VERIFY PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================

required_predictions = {
    "XGBoost + TS-ResNet": xgb_ts_pred,
    "RF": rf_pred,
    "DT": dt_pred,
    "SVM": svm_pred,
    "KNN": knn_pred,
    "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]": danfis_pred
}

for model_name, predictions in required_predictions.items():

    if len(predictions) != len(BASE_Y_TEST):

        raise ValueError(
            f"{model_name} prediction length "
            f"({len(predictions)}) does not match "
            f"test-set length ({len(BASE_Y_TEST)})."
        )


# ============================================================
# 3. FUNCTION FOR PAIRED T-TEST
# ============================================================

def paired_ttest_model(
    baseline_name,
    baseline_pred,
    proposed_name,
    proposed_pred,
    y_true
):

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Correct / incorrect for every test sample
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    baseline_correct = (
        baseline_pred == y_true
    ).astype(float)

    proposed_correct = (
        proposed_pred == y_true
    ).astype(float)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Paired difference
    #
    # Positive value = proposed model correct while
    # baseline is incorrect.
    #
    # Negative value = baseline correct while
    # proposed model is incorrect.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    differences = (
        proposed_correct
        -
        baseline_correct
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Baseline mean and SD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    baseline_mean = (
        np.mean(baseline_correct)
        * 100
    )

    baseline_sd = (
        np.std(
            baseline_correct,
            ddof=1
        )
        * 100
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Proposed mean
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    proposed_mean = (
        np.mean(proposed_correct)
        * 100
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Mean difference
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mean_difference = (
        np.mean(differences)
        * 100
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Paired t-test
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    t_statistic, p_value = ttest_rel(
        proposed_correct,
        baseline_correct
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 95% confidence interval
    #
    # CI is calculated on the paired differences.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    n = len(differences)

    mean_diff = np.mean(
        differences
    )

    sd_diff = np.std(
        differences,
        ddof=1
    )

    standard_error = (
        sd_diff
        /
        np.sqrt(n)
    )

    # t critical value
    from scipy.stats import t

    t_critical = t.ppf(
        1 - ALPHA / 2,
        df=n - 1
    )

    ci_margin = (
        t_critical
        * standard_error
    )

    ci_lower = (
        (mean_diff - ci_margin)
        * 100
    )

    ci_upper = (
        (mean_diff + ci_margin)
        * 100
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # p-value formatting
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if p_value < 0.001:

        p_report = "<0.001"

    else:

        p_report = f"{p_value:.4f}"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Significance
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if p_value < ALPHA:

        significance = "Highly Significant"

    else:

        significance = "Not Significant"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Return result
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return {

        "Model":
            f"{baseline_name} vs "
            f"{proposed_name}",

        "Baseline Mean ± SD (%)":
            f"{baseline_mean:.2f} ± "
            f"{baseline_sd:.2f}",

        "Mean Diff (%)":
            f"{mean_difference:.2f}",

        "CI Lower":
            f"{ci_lower:.2f}",

        "CI Upper":
            f"{ci_upper:.2f}",

        "p (report)":
            p_report,

        "Significance (α=0.05)":
            significance
    }


# ============================================================
# 4. RUN PAIRED T-TESTS
# ============================================================

statistical_results = []


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# XGBoost + TS-ResNet
# ------------------------------------------------------------

statistical_results.append(
    paired_ttest_model(
        "XGBoost + TS-ResNet",
        xgb_ts_pred,
        "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]",
        danfis_pred,
        BASE_Y_TEST
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Random Forest
# ------------------------------------------------------------

statistical_results.append(
    paired_ttest_model(
        "RF",
        rf_pred,
        "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]",
        danfis_pred,
        BASE_Y_TEST
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision Tree
# ------------------------------------------------------------

statistical_results.append(
    paired_ttest_model(
        "DT",
        dt_pred,
        "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]",
        danfis_pred,
        BASE_Y_TEST
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SVM
# ------------------------------------------------------------

statistical_results.append(
    paired_ttest_model(
        "SVM",
        svm_pred,
        "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]",
        danfis_pred,
        BASE_Y_TEST
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KNN
# ------------------------------------------------------------

statistical_results.append(
    paired_ttest_model(
        "KNN",
        knn_pred,
        "DANFIS-DE-NN [Proposed]",
        danfis_pred,
        BASE_Y_TEST
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 5. DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

statistical_df = pd.DataFrame(
    statistical_results
)


# ============================================================
# 6. PRINT STATISTICAL TABLE
# ============================================================


print("=" * 135)
print("STATISTICAL SIGNIFICANCE ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 135)

print(
    statistical_df.to_string(
        index=False
    )
)
